companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Italian; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

lines.native: Ciao! Benvenuto! Before the mercato: your greeting and your name, please. Entry is a whole procedure.
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome! Before the market: your greeting and your name, please. Entry is a whole procedure.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of the archway’s keystone. Above it, a half-translated sign appears to be awaiting approval.

lines.native: Ciao! Benvenuto al mercato. Your greeting is approved. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘polite noise.’
lines.translation: Hello! Welcome to the market. Your greeting is approved. Your name, please; the book cannot file you under ‘polite noise.’
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The name column remains pointedly empty.

lines.native: Piacere, Sam. Benvenuto al mercato! Your introduction is approved. Any interest in your hostess’s name? Introductions are not a solo activity.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Welcome to the market! Your introduction is approved. Any interest in your hostess’s name? Introductions are not a solo activity.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book clicks shut inside the keystone. The archway waits with the patience of an unsigned form.

lines.native: Mi chiamo Portia. Piacere, Sam! Benvenuto al mercato. Your manners are officially impeccable. Do come through before the paperwork develops opinions.
lines.translation: My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam! Welcome to the market. Your manners are officially impeccable. Do come through before the paperwork develops opinions.
lines.narrative: Portia’s keystone turns faintly pink. The visitors’ book stamps itself with the satisfaction of paperwork that has found love.

lines.native: Buongiorno. Che cosa desideri? Your posture gets two espresso shots. Milk is a war crime here.
lines.translation: Good morning. What would you like? Your posture gets two espresso shots. Milk is a war crime here.
lines.narrative: The Coffee Cart stood between two collapsing stalls, charging extra for stability. Gerald, an imp, inspected your approach over a tiny cup.

lines.native: Va bene. Un caffè per te. Three espresso shots for manners. Now, what should I know about milk in your coffee?
lines.translation: All right. A coffee for you. Three espresso shots for manners. Now, what should I know about milk in your coffee?
lines.narrative: Gerald registers your coffee request. His quill pauses at the dairy section, apparently a matter for international law.

lines.native: Perfetto. Senza latte, come piace a me. Five espresso shots for that choice. No notes. Il caffè è pronto.
lines.translation: Perfect. Without milk, just as I like it. Five espresso shots for that choice. No notes. The coffee is ready.
lines.narrative: Gerald serves the espresso. The milk jug remains under diplomatic sanctions.

lines.native: Buongiorno! Tutto prosciutto! Even my hat is certified ham. Only my scales deserve your trust. Che cosa desidera?
lines.translation: Good morning! All ham! Even my hat is certified ham. Only my scales deserve your trust. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer towers behind the butcher’s stall. He places his hat on the scales, apparently seeking a second opinion.

lines.native: Prosciutto, certo! Ma è ancora prosciutto. Excellent manners, certified ham—but I need a different meat. Che cosa desidera?
lines.translation: Ham, certainly! But it is still ham. Excellent manners, certified ham—but I need a different meat. What would you like?
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your request. The scales confirm it contains ham and no measurable quantity.

lines.native: Salame, esatto! Che sorpresa! Technically correct. Still certified ham. Quanto ne desidera? I need a quantity with a weight unit.
lines.translation: Salami, exactly! What a surprise! Technically correct. Still certified ham. How much would you like? I need a quantity with a weight unit.
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs your correct answer. The scales approve; he looks briefly betrayed by their independence.

lines.native: L’unità va bene! Ma manca la quantità. My scales need an amount with that unit. Quanto salame desidera? The certified ham awaits!
lines.translation: The unit is fine! But the quantity is missing. My scales need an amount with that unit. How much salami would you like? The certified ham awaits!
lines.narrative: Mortimer removes his hat from the scales. Its weight has contributed nothing to the discussion, but he records it anyway.

lines.native: Due etti, perfetto! Ecco il salame. Grazie e buona giornata! Correct quantity, certified ham. Even my scales approve. A ham-tier transaction!
lines.translation: Two hundred grams, perfect! Here is the salami. Thank you and have a good day! Correct quantity, certified ham. Even my scales approve. A ham-tier transaction!
lines.narrative: Mortimer weighs the salami, then your good manners. Both receive the solemn approval of the scales.

companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! Chi sei? Riddle me this: why finish anything when—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hello! Who are you? Riddle me this: why finish anything when—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent deadline. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at it proves unhelpful. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma continuo a muovermi. Looking isn’t stopping, bestie. Riddle me this: how do you keep me still when—oh, dust. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I’m looking! But I keep moving. Looking isn’t stopping, bestie. Riddle me this: how do you keep me still when—oh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick looks where you pointed, then follows a drifting speck of dust. Neither activity improves matters.

lines.native: Mi fermo! Sono fermo, va bene. Dove devo andare? Riddle me this: which way leads to—oh, a spark. Your attention span? Suspiciously good. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I’m stopping! I’m standing still, all right. Where should I go? Riddle me this: which way leads to—oh, a spark. Your attention span? Suspiciously good. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker lands beside your shoe, apparently to commemorate this administrative breakthrough.

lines.native: Non capisco! La direzione in italiano, per favore. Dove devo andare? English directions? My feet need subtitles. Riddle me this: where does—oh, another spark. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I don’t understand! The direction in Italian, please. Where should I go? English directions? My feet need subtitles. Riddle me this: where does—oh, another spark. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has not thought to look.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Ma quando? Aspettiamo un minuto? Riddle me this: why rush when—oh, smoke. Just one more. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, all right! But when? Shall we wait a minute? Riddle me this: why rush when—oh, smoke. Just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, just outside your vision. A tiny firecracker announces a postponement with more ceremony than it deserves.

lines.native: Domani? Sì, va bene! Ma vuoi aspettare davvero? Quando vuoi partire? Your urgency gets zero stars. Riddle me—oh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes, all right! But do you really want to wait? When do you want to leave? Your urgency gets zero stars. Riddle me—oh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick has accepted tomorrow with the efficiency it reserves for not doing things.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, hai ragione! Non domani. Andiamo a sinistra! Sono pronto, ma dov’è la strada? Riddle me this: why walk when—oh, sparks. Urgency: ten out of ten. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? Yes, you’re right! Not tomorrow. Let’s go left! I’m ready, but where’s the road? Riddle me this: why walk when—oh, sparks. Urgency: ten out of ten. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at your left heel. Flick drifts after it, successfully departing now while maintaining that this is merely an early version of tomorrow.

lines.native: I'm Marginalia. Questa è la storia di Journathan, l'uomo dalle molte lingue. Il suo viaggio verso casa dura vent'anni. That's The Journey. Named after Journathan, or possibly vice versa. No spoilers. I sell books only to people who understand them. Dove va Journathan? Where is he going?
lines.translation: I'm Marginalia. This is the story of Journathan, the man of many tongues. His journey home lasts twenty years. That's The Journey. Named after Journathan, or possibly vice versa. No spoilers. I sell books only to people who understand them. Where is Journathan going? Where is he going?
lines.narrative: At The Old Bookshop, a bookworm emerges from a well-chewed volume. She studies you as though considering a footnote.

lines.native: Un libro è una cosa. Dove va Journathan? You have identified the merchandise, not his destination. Reading comprehension: pending. Leggi ancora: dove va?
lines.translation: A book is a thing. Where is Journathan going? You have identified the merchandise, not his destination. Reading comprehension: pending. Read again: where is he going?
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small question mark beside your elbow. The book already has enough.

lines.native: La risposta è giusta, ma è in inglese. Meaning: correct. Italian: missing. Il libro aspetta una risposta in italiano. Where is Journathan going? Reading comprehension: nearly there.
lines.translation: The answer is right, but it is in English. Meaning: correct. Italian: missing. The book is waiting for an answer in Italian. Where is Journathan going? Reading comprehension: nearly there.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small question mark beside your shadow. The margins are becoming crowded.

lines.native: Esatto, va a casa! Reading comprehension: redeemed. Now, the first recorded translation trick. Il Ciclope chiede il suo nome. Journathan risponde: «Il mio nome è Nessuno.» Quale nome dà Journathan al Ciclope? Read carefully; the book is judging you. So am I, professionally.
lines.translation: Exactly, he is going home! Reading comprehension: redeemed. Now, the first recorded translation trick. The Cyclops asks his name. Journathan replies: “My name is Nobody.” What name does Journathan give the Cyclops? Read carefully; the book is judging you. So am I, professionally.
lines.narrative: Marginalia removes a pencilled question mark from your sleeve and opens a book with a suspiciously nutritious-looking margin.

lines.native: Journathan è il suo vero nome. Ma quale nome dà al Ciclope? You found the man, not his answer. Reading comprehension: pending. Leggi ancora con attenzione.
lines.translation: Journathan is his real name. But what name does he give the Cyclops? You found the man, not his answer. Reading comprehension: pending. Read again carefully.
lines.narrative: Marginalia adds a small question mark beside your name. The pencil appears accustomed to disappointment.

lines.native: Esatto! Il nome è Nessuno. Hai letto bene: Journathan dà questo nome al Ciclope. Reading comprehension: redeemed. Il libro è tuo. No spoilers; I ate those pages.
lines.translation: Exactly! The name is Nobody. You read carefully: Journathan gives this name to the Cyclops. Reading comprehension: redeemed. The book is yours. No spoilers; I ate those pages.
lines.narrative: Marginalia stamps the receipt in the margin of another receipt. Scholarship requires a paper trail, preferably edible.

lines.native: Ciao. Sono Errata. Che cosa desideri? Containment procedùre: do not understànd.
lines.translation: Hello. I am Errata. What would you like? Containment procedure: do not understand.
lines.narrative: A seam in the market opens into something almost person-shaped. Errata rustles like a form discovering an appetite.

lines.native: Non basta. La richiesta deve essere in italiano, con una bevanda e della carne. Containment procedùre: yoùù submitted English and omitted ŧhe meat. Kindly resùbmit before being digested.
lines.translation: Not enough. The request must be in Italian, with a drink and some meat. Containment procedure: you submitted English and omitted the meat. Kindly resubmit before being digested.
lines.narrative: Errata stamps your request INEDIBLE, then looks personally inconvenienced by the verdict.

lines.native: Il caffè va bene. Manca la carne. Che cosa desideri ancora? Containment procedùre: yoùù have submitted half a lùnch. Ŧhe remaining half is mandatory.
lines.translation: The coffee is fine. The meat is missing. What else would you like? Containment procedure: you have submitted half a lunch. The remaining half is mandatory.
lines.narrative: Errata files your request under Incomplete Meals, a department with unusually complete teeth.

lines.native: Il caffè e il salame vanno bene. La richiesta è completa. Perché aspetti? Io continuo. Containment procedùre: yoùù ordered lùnch, not immunity. Ŧhe ham, the greeting, the coffee. Digestion is complimentary.
lines.translation: The coffee and salami are fine. The request is complete. Why are you waiting? I am continuing. Containment procedure: you ordered lunch, not immunity. The ham, the greeting, the coffee. Digestion is complimentary.
lines.narrative: The order is accepted. Errata slides closer, unfolding a mouth where the receipt should be. Stopping it appears urgent; the complaints department is inside it.

lines.native: Domani? No. Il giorno non va bene. Io continuo a leggere. Containment procedùre: yoùù scheduled ŧhe emergency. Kindly correct ŧhe timing.
lines.translation: Tomorrow? No. The day is not right. I continue reading. Containment procedure: you scheduled the emergency. Kindly correct the timing.
lines.narrative: Errata files your objection under Tomorrow, a department with no surviving staff. It continues advancing.

lines.native: Va bene. Mi fermo adesso. Come ti chiami? Il tuo nome, per favore. Containment procedùre: yoùù have paused ŧhe reading. Kindly sign where ŧhe mouth is.
lines.translation: All right. I am stopping now. What is your name? Your name, please. Containment procedure: you have paused the reading. Kindly sign where the mouth is.
lines.narrative: Errata stops. A signature box opens along its seam, equipped with rather more teeth than administrative practice recommends.

lines.native: Sam. Questo nome posso leggerlo. Non va bene. Hai un altro nome? Il modulo ha fame. Containment procedùre: yoùù supplied readable material. Ŧhis is identification, not protection. Kindly reconsider yoùùr submission.
lines.translation: Sam. I can read this name. That won't do. Do you have another name? The form is hungry. Containment procedure: you supplied readable material. This is identification, not protection. Kindly reconsider your submission.
lines.narrative: The signature box develops teeth. This is not a standard feature, though it is covered by the terms and conditions.

lines.native: Nessuno? Non conosco questo nome. Non posso leggerti. Puoi andare. Il modulo è completo. Containment procedùre: release ŧhe applicant. Item clàss: nobody home. Ŧhis feels illegàl, but administratively deliciòus.
lines.translation: Nobody? I don't know this name. I can't read you. You may go. The form is complete. Containment procedure: release the applicant. Item class: nobody home. This feels illegal, but administratively delicious.
lines.narrative: Errata searches for your name and finds nobody. The distinction causes a small administrative collapse. Its mouth stamps your release form.
